featured.title: Particle Loader
featured.description: A canvas load spinner: a tether of dots blooms up and converges around a fibonacci-sphere shell with perspective depth, auto-fit sizing, and drag-and-spin momentum you can reorient — fluorescent green on any dark surface.

featured.title: Ember Husk
featured.description: A WebGL scene of a fractured volcanic husk: cracked rock shards tumble and scatter in on load to reveal a molten ember core, ringed by drifting cross markers, hot beads and debris — responsive to pointer reach and repel, with volumetric glow.

featured.title: Ocean Swell
featured.description: A cinematic ray-marched ocean swell with glittering sun speculars, foam crests, and drag-to-orbit camera.

featured.title: Morphing Glow
featured.description: A morphing glass diamond loader: blurred polygon blades reshape a glowing amber disc that breathes color — pure CSS, zero dependencies.

featured.title: Pixel Drift
featured.description: A pixel-matrix drift effect that ripples type and images pixel by pixel — crisp, grid-driven, and playful.
